about_the_game:
You will get the cleanest desktop in the world without the need for organization.

You will become more focused in daily gaming, work, and entertainment.

You will obtain a new generation of computer operation methods with convenience far beyond ordinary users.

It will make your computer a personalized one that others cannot easily operate, protecting your privacy.

It will make your computer unique.

✨ Core Advantages

🧹 One-Click Tidy-Up
Solve desktop clutter with a single click—own the world’s most organized desktop instantly.

🔒 Privacy Protection
Respects your privacy! Whether in meetings, live streams, or presentations, others can only see your active windows. Even if someone else uses your PC, they won’t be able to browse other files.

⚡ Efficient Operation
A fresh, intuitive workflow with multiple quick-launch options—faster than clicking icons directly!

🎓 Zero Learning Curve
Built-in smart logic works right out of the box—no setup needed, perfect for beginners.

🚀 Lightweight & Efficient
Tiny footprint, no strain on storage, CPU, RAM, or network. A true offline tool with zero background resource usage.

🛠️ Powerful Features

🎛️ Quick Actions

⌨️ Custom Hotkeys – Open any file or app instantly.
🖱️ Right-Click Menu – Add favorite files/apps to the context menu.
📂 Virtual Desktop Folders – Create them instantly via hotkeys (default).
🔌 One-Click Shutdown – A cool and practical shortcut (enabled by default).

⚙️ Advanced Settings

🔔 Startup Options – Auto-launch, hide on startup, or hide the desktop—customizable.
🔍 Instant File Search – Integrated "Everything" engine for quick file access (disabled by default).

🎨 Personalization

🎬 Dynamic Wallpapers – Supports video wallpapers (user-provided, disabled by default).
🖱️ Animated Cursors – Custom mouse pointers (user-provided, disabled by default).
🖼️ Wallpaper Manager – Convert dynamic wallpapers to static for easy saving.
🎭 Skins/Themes – Customize the UI to match your desktop style.

🌟 Why Choose It?

✔ Tidy – No more clutter, one-click cleanup.
✔ Secure – Privacy-first, worry-free usage.
✔ Fast – Smoother and quicker than ever.
✔ Offline – No background processes, no internet needed.

Tech that makes computing simpler and more elegant!

⚠ Note: Some antivirus programs may falsely flag this app. Adding it to your trusted list resolves the issue. Rest assured—it’s 100% safe.
detailed_description:
Game will not launch

I can't download it

Because this software is falsely reported as a virus by many antivirus software, it will be deleted when you download it. Here's how Microsoft's default antivirus software handles, and other antiviruses do the same.

Here are the steps to add a trusted item in Windows Security Center:

Click on Settings, search for Security Center, and select Windows Security.

Select Windows Security and click to open it.

Click on Virus & threat protection, then click on Virus & threat protection settings to access Manage settings.

Locate Exclusions and click on Add or remove exclusions.

  • Click on + Add an exclusion, and select the folder you want to trust, such as ***\Steam\steamapps\common\Blank Wallpaper.

  • Real-time protection also needs to be temporarily turned off while downloading. It can be turned on before running.

  • There is a "demo" in the "tool" in the library, which has basic functions.
